Read and write native measurement acquisition bundles

Source: R/acquisition-io.R
measure-acquisition-bundle.Rd

Acquisition bundles use one fixed DCF manifest and twelve flat CSV or TSV payloads. The profile retains linked scalar record metadata, raw MS scans, and two-dimensional measurement arrays. It does not infer missing scans, units, interpretation, or source identity.

Usage

write_measure_acquisition(x, path, delim = c(",", "\t"))

read_measure_acquisition(path, max_bytes = 100 * 1024^2)

Arguments

x

A validated measure_acquisition object.

path

For writing, a new local directory path whose parent exists. For reading, a directory containing a complete acquisition bundle.

delim

A comma or tab field delimiter used for all payloads.

max_bytes

A positive whole-number limit for actual cumulative bytes read from the manifest and twelve selected payloads.

Value

write_measure_acquisition() invisibly returns the normalized destination path. read_measure_acquisition() returns a validated measure_acquisition object.

Bundle version 1

The selected files and exact ordered headers are specified in inst/specs/measure-acquisition-v1.md. All selected members have fixed names; manifest paths are never interpreted. Payload hashes cover exact bytes and detect changes, but do not authenticate a source.

The writer validates supported object attributes before staging, reads back the staged bundle and checks fidelity, then reserves a new destination and publishes the manifest last. Existing paths are never replaced.
